verdict.rationale: Flagright's API reference states that it maintains official API clients for Python and Node/TypeScript and recommends them for all stable endpoints, so the core story is delivered first-party. Downloadable OpenAPI specs for both the FRAML and Management APIs also support building against the API. Missing for 10: detailed SDK documentation (installation, versioning, coverage of non-stable endpoints), SDKs beyond Python and Node/TypeScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Flagright maintains official API clients for Python and Node/Typescript. We recommend using these clients to interact with all stable endpoints.
